hooks.logic:
Let part be part 1 of the enemy.
Let hpRate be the phase for part under the phases list with HP fraction (the HP fraction of part) from phase the register's 'ochuBpIdx'.
If condition flag "sos_a_done" is up this frame or condition flag "sos_b_done" is up this frame or condition flag "sos_c_done" is up this frame, then increase the register's 'sosNum' by one.
If condition flag "ochu_ability_done" is up this frame and the main move id of the last move of part is the id of the move labelled "pollen" on part, then
  Set the register's 'sosNum' to 0.
  Let data be {commTag: "pollen_done"}.
  The enemy → notify-communication-to-child with (2, data).
  The enemy → notify-communication-to-child with (3, data).
  The enemy → notify-communication-to-child with (4, data).
If not a move is already queued, then
  If the register's 'ochuBpIdx' is not hpRate, then
    Part changes to stat block the stat block of form list at hpRate's 'paramSuffixNo' on part.
    Part cancels its cast.
    Set the register's 'ochuBpIdx' to hpRate and stop.
  If part is ready to act, then
    If the register's 'sosNum' is at least the numeric entry "sos_num_for_pollen" in the battle settings of the enemy, then
      Let ability be the id of the move labelled "pollen" on part.
      Part uses ability with its cast time and then [{abilityTag: "pollen"}, {abilityTag: "pollen2", abilityOptions: call game:ai.AiUtil.makeAbilityOptionsForSubEffect}].
    Otherwise
      Let ability2 be a weighted random move of part other than the excluded moves of part with options {forceIgnoresReflection: false}.
      Let ability3 be the id of the move labelled "scream" on part.
      If ability2 is ability3, then
        If part 2 of the enemy is dead and part 3 of the enemy is dead and part 4 of the enemy is dead, then part uses ability3.
        Otherwise, part uses ability3 with its cast time and then [{abilityTag: "scream"}, {abilityTag: "scream2", abilityOptions: call game:ai.AiUtil.makeAbilityOptionsForSubEffect}].
      Otherwise, part uses ability2.

Given arg1, arg2, arg3.
Return {conditionFlagTag: arg1, condition: {class: "AbilityCountTransitCondition", args: _ → extend with ({id: arg2, whenDone: true, count: 1}, arg3)}}.
